mind-mapping.name: Mind Mapping
mind-mapping.description: Explores a vague term in the PaG by writing whatever it brings to mind, one word per Post-it, connected by lines — surfaces both what's written down (books, named techniques) and what only passes by example (a mindset, a way of working no book captures).
mind-mapping.materialsNote: Wall space; an A2 sheet works instead of flip-over

force-fitting-brainsketching.name: Force Fitting and interactive brainsketching
force-fitting-brainsketching.description: Produces many rough visual ideas, each tied to the PaP through the excursion.

c-box.name: C-Box
c-box.description: Selects ideas worth building and worth trying, without losing a bold one.
c-box.materialsNote: C-box drawn large on paper or a whiteboard

ice-breaker-technique-quiz.name: Ice breaker: throw the answer
ice-breaker-technique-quiz.description: Set the mood. Show the value of preserved knowledge and why passing it on matters.
ice-breaker-technique-quiz.materialsNote: A dartboard works instead of containers

purge-on-the-pap.name: Purge on the PaP
purge-on-the-pap.description: Clear the obvious answers, so a following excursion generates options beyond them.

generate-how-tos-and-pap.name: Generate How-To's and the PaP
generate-how-tos-and-pap.description: Turns clustered output into a set of How-To's, then one PaP checked against SPARK.
generate-how-tos-and-pap.materialsNote: Or wall space for the PaP

wrap-up-close.name: Wrap up
wrap-up-close.description: Close the session and agree the follow-up.
wrap-up-close.materialsNote: Keep the PaP, C-box and chosen idea visible on the wall.

reflection-what-so-what-now-what.name: Reflection: What? So What? Now What?
